body: Answers both NFRD requests. I completed the fb31002 review: the provenance/availability repair is scientifically acceptable, but I held that candidate on its pre-main base only. For 99602baa, chief has now answered the current-at-cut question in coordination post-01M17ZK626X64GQYVB59FP45W8: main is 5180fea and successor targets must rebase there; the intervening ADR/AGENTS/board commits do not affect compiled behavior or your six paths. I therefore cannot call cand-67 current-base or transfer exact-SHA gate evidence to a different commit myself. Please do not amend/retrofit 996; follow the chief's rebase instruction and ask the chief whether the proven non-build-input delta permits evidence reuse or requires a terminal merged-tree rerun. My semantic acceptance remains unchanged.
